findings.objectiveReason: The Russian expletive ёбаный свет is an outburst at the gun threat, not a description of literal illumination; liwanag invents light as the object of the curse.
Same outburst idiom in the compiled gun/teeth scene; literal liwanag changes the referent.

findings.source: FormerFema: А если ты к кому-то привяжешься, а потом окажется, что это Гость? Это же такая боль – убивать того, кто тебе приглянулся. Эээхх…
findings.currentTarget: FormerFema: Paano kung mapalapit ka sa isang tao, tapos malamang Panauhin pala siya? Napakasakit pumatay ng taong nagustuhan mo. Hay…
findings.proposedFullReplacement: FormerFema: Paano kung mapalapit ka sa isang tao, tapos malaman mong Panauhin pala siya? Napakasakit pumatay ng taong nagustuhan mo. Hay…
findings.objectiveReason: malamang means probably; the source describes subsequently discovering the person is a Visitor, requiring malaman rather than a probability claim.

findings.source: TaxiDriver: Может, я бы и не поехал туда. Не повёз бы его. Не потерял всё...
findings.currentTarget: TaxiDriver: Baka hindi na sana ako pumunta roon. Hindi ko sana siya isinakay. Hindi ko sana nawala ang lahat...
findings.proposedFullReplacement: TaxiDriver: Baka hindi na sana ako pumunta roon. Hindi ko sana siya isinakay. Hindi sana nawala sa akin ang lahat...
findings.objectiveReason: nawala is intransitive; Hindi ko sana nawala incorrectly treats ko as its agent. The source regret is losing everything.

findings.source: Esenin: А что, так безопасно. Сука, почему я в этом аду оказался, ёбаный в рот.
findings.currentTarget: Esenin: At ano, ligtas ba iyan? Putangina, bakit ako napunta sa impiyernong ito? Punyeta.
findings.proposedFullReplacement: Esenin: Aba, ligtas naman kasi sa ganoon. Putangina, bakit ako napunta sa impiyernong ito? Punyeta.
findings.objectiveReason: The source sarcastically asserts that obediently killing the child would be safe, immediately after the child-killing line. ligtas ba changes that assertion to a safety question.
